criteria.rationale: Born October 3, 1990, the patient was 35 on the September 1, 2026 request date.
The request is for chronic weight management, and the prescribing note plans Wegovy for obesity.
The August note documents continued diet and bike workouts and directs the patient to continue both alongside Wegovy. Dietitian notes identify the diet as reduced-calorie and document ongoing biking.

Enrollment in a lifestyle modification program was documented December 12, 2025; subsequent notes document diet, activity, and continuing follow-up through August 12, 2026—eight whole calendar months, with no documented stop.
The latest structured BMI before the request was 36.4 kg/m², exceeding the primary threshold of 30.

parsed.summary: All five modeled criteria are met. The patient is 35, Wegovy is requested for chronic weight management, the recent plan continues reduced-calorie diet and activity alongside treatment, program participation is documented for eight months, and the latest BMI is 36.4.
